newsitem.title: CANADA: Nuinsco, Cambior end joint project.
newsitem.headline: Nuinsco, Cambior end joint project.

text.p: Nuinsco Resources Ltd said on Friday that it has agreed with Cambior Inc to terminate a joint project on Nuinsco's Cameron Lake gold deposit in northwestern Ontario.
Cambior, which completed 13 diamond drill holes on the property at a cost of C$822,400, forfeits its option and will have no interest in the deposit, Nuinsco said.
The Cambior drill results do not alter previously reported tonnage and grade figures for the property's orebody, Nuinsco added.

H. Douglas Hume, Nuinsco's president, said the termination of the agreement between the two companies leaves Nuinsco free to study other joint production opportunities and enhance Nuinsco shareholder value.
